tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The ground every toolkit view sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, choices and tables, on paper.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the sole sign of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (choices, inputs, secondary buttons). Meets 3:1 on paper and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on paper, surface, action-soft and attention.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, counts, on paper and surface.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected choices, links and the current stage. One meaning: something you can do.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a primary button.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and checkmarks on an action fill.

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: Hover behind quiet buttons and the step numbers' disc; ink or action text on it.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Fill of the Needs-you status and the current segment of Progress only. The loudest colour in the system; never decoration.

tokens.name: on-attention
tokens.usage: Text on an attention fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Done status text and its check, on surface or done-soft.

tokens.name: done-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind done text.

tokens.name: refusal
tokens.usage: Errors and server refusals (the gate said no), on surface or refusal-soft. Always with a sentence saying what to fix.

tokens.name: refusal-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind refusal text.

tokens.name: model
tokens.usage: Text the model wrote that nobody has decided yet, on surface or model-soft.

tokens.name: model-line
tokens.usage: Dashed border around model drafts. Dashed means provisional.

tokens.name: model-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a model draft.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. An alias of action.

tokens.name: code-1
tokens.usage: Categorical colour for codes, lenses and chart series, first. Marks only (swatches, lines, nodes), never text.

tokens.name: code-2
tokens.usage: Categorical colour, second. Marks only.

tokens.name: code-3
tokens.usage: Categorical colour, third. Marks only.

tokens.name: code-4
tokens.usage: Categorical colour, fourth. Marks only.

tokens.name: code-5
tokens.usage: Categorical colour, fifth. Marks only.

tokens.name: code-6
tokens.usage: Categorical colour, sixth. Past six codes, repeat with the code name always shown.

color.note: Harbor: navy on cool grey, with yellow kept for what needs the researcher.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page or project title. Once per view.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: A card's title: a code, a disagreement, a source.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two coding passes agreed on 208 of 212 chunks.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, status words, table headers. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Choose at least one code, or exclude the chunk.
styles.usage: Hints, captions and the reason beside a disabled button.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Chunk and job IDs and positions in a queue, in ink-muted. IDs in the interface use the sans; there is no typewriter face on screen.

styles.name: model-label
styles.usage: The label on anything the model wrote, in model colour inside its dashed box.

styles.name: passage
styles.sample: When the compressor died, it was the bodega owner who paid for the repair.
styles.usage: Quoted data: interview chunks, field notes, documents. The largest text in a decision: the participant's words are what is being decided about.

styles.name: raw
styles.usage: Exported JSON, ratification IDs a researcher may copy, and code blocks. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between choices, between chips, label to field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside choices and chips; between a button and its reason.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside small cards; between fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Inside decision cards; between groups in a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between cards and between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above a stage heading; page top and bottom.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and table corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Boxes inside a card (model drafts, your decision, notices) and collapsed done rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The decision card. Nothing else is this round.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, choices, status pills, code tags, step numbers and Progress segments.

size.note: Fixed sizes the components rely on.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything clickable.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text and passages.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a toolkit page. One decision at a time reads best narrow.
